references.text: The Gadites and Reubenites respond to Moses' accusation by proposing that they will go armed ahead of the Israelites into battle.
The spies who brought a bad report about the land led the people to refuse entering the war over Canaan—a similar situation where some refuse to join the fight.
The Israelites refused to enter the land after the spies' report, something Moses feared would be repeated with Gad and Reuben.
Moses reminds the tribes east of the Jordan of their obligation to help their brothers in battle before they could settle down.
Joshua reminds Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh that they must help their brothers in war, as Moses had commanded.
Joshua sends Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh home after they fulfilled their duty by fighting alongside their brothers.
